welcomeBody: Every empire starts small. In the next few minutes you will name your lair, pick a villain persona, invite your first minion and choose a nemesis. You can change all of it later, except the nemesis, who will not let you forget.
lairNameHelp: Minions see this name on every memo. Pick something they can spell.
inviteMinion.help: We'll send {{email}} an invitation with a link to join {{lair}}. Minions can run schemes and borrow gadgets, but only you can approve a doomsday device. You can promote them to henchman once they stop pressing the red button.
nemesisHint: Your nemesis is the hero who shows up whenever a scheme is about to work. Picking one now means we can warn you before they arrive, which is more than most villains get.
nemesisSelected: {{hero}} is now your nemesis. They have been notified. Probably.
tour.dashboard: This is your dashboard. Every foiled scheme shows up here, sadly.
tour.devices: Doomsday devices live here. Charge them before you threaten anyone.
